item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 06/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will bring slightly cooler weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather will be generally fine over the region with relatively large temperature difference between day and night over inland areas. A replenishment of the monsoon will affect the coast of southern China midweek next week. Temperatures will fall again over the region.

Date/Month: 06/01 (Thursday)
Wind: Light winds force 2 at first, becoming northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore later.
Weather: Mainly fine.
Temp range: 18 - 23 C
R.H. range: 60 - 85 per Cent
PSR: Low
